Implementation Journey

From Sign-Up to Full Go-Live in Days, Not Months

Our proven 5-step process gets your business running on TallyPrime quickly, correctly, and with full team buy-in.

01

Requirements Gathering

We understand your business — your industry, team size, workflows, and pain points — to design the right TallyPrime setup for you.

02

Solution Design

We configure TallyPrime editions, chart of accounts, inventory structure, and reporting dashboards tailored to your business.

03

Implementation & Migration

We install, configure, and migrate your existing data — from spreadsheets or legacy software — into TallyPrime with zero data loss.

04

Training & Go-Live

Your team gets hands-on training from our certified consultants. We stay with you through go-live to ensure a smooth transition.

05

Ongoing Support

Post-implementation, our Kenya-based team provides priority support, software updates, and quarterly business reviews.
